hypotheses.title: Domestic EBIT Yield Valuation Disparity (TOP3000 Subindustry Neutral, Decay 6)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: In Batch 120, Candidate 1 cleared all 8 platform gates with Sharpe 1.62 and Turnover 13.62% in TOP1000. Expanding universe to TOP3000 triples cross-sectional diversification across 3,000 equities, depressing portfolio self-correlation from 0.59 down to <= 0.45 while harvesting wider valuation spreads from mid/small caps to catapult Fitness >= 1.80 for Alpha 1.
confounders: Small-cap illiquidity shocks during market stress
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha inverts if domestic revenue growth collapses relative to foreign earnings across the broad equity market.

hypotheses.title: Foreign Operating Earnings Yield (TOP3000 Subindustry Neutral, Decay 6)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: In Batch 120, Candidate 2 delivered Sharpe 1.62, Fitness 1.26, and 13.85% turnover. Transitioning to TOP3000 dilutes large-cap common factors, driving self-correlation <= 0.45 and capturing multinational export yield across the broader economy to push Fitness >= 1.80 for Alpha 2.
confounders: Global trade disruptions and currency volatility
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha fails during periods of severe global trade contractions.

hypotheses.title: Long-Term Debt Burden to Capital Disparity (TOP3000 Subindustry Neutral, Decay 6)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Sibling to approved alpha b2bea437 (which scored Sharpe 1.73 and Fitness 1.66 in TOP3000 Subindustry). Isolates funded balance sheet long-term debt burden relative to asset backing. Zero approved alphas in database for debt_lt in Subindustry, guaranteeing low correlation (<= 0.45) with income statement models, and Decay 6 compresses turnover to ~11% for Fitness >= 1.80 for Alpha 3.
confounders: Corporate debt restructurings and debt-for-equity swaps
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha fails if highly levered companies systematically outperform low-debt peers during speculative debt binges.
